# STooltip `<s-tooltip>`

A short label that appears when another element is hovered or focused. `STooltip` is the typed Vue 3 wrapper for Shopify's Polaris `<s-tooltip>` web component.

```ts
import { STooltip } from 'polaris-vue-elements'
```

## Best practices

- **Use tooltips for extra, non-essential detail.** They suit information that adds understanding but isn't required. Never hide errors, essential information or required instructions in a tooltip.
- **Pair them with icon-only buttons.** An icon button needs a tooltip to explain what it does; include the action and, if there is one, its keyboard shortcut.
- **Keep the text brief.** A short phrase or sentence is ideal. If the content runs long, it probably deserves a more visible spot in the UI.
- **Treat many tooltips as a warning sign.** If the interface needs lots of them to make sense, improve the labels, layout or information architecture instead.
- **Remember touch devices.** Tooltips only work on desktop and don't appear on touch screens, so show important information by default on mobile.

```vue
<SButton icon="delete" accessibilityLabel="Delete product" interestFor="delete-tip" />
<STooltip id="delete-tip">Delete product</STooltip>
```

See [Shopify's best practices for `<s-tooltip>`](https://shopify.dev/docs/api/app-home/latest/web-components/typography-and-content/tooltip#best-practices) for the full guidance.

## Example

<script setup>
import STooltipDemo from '../examples/demos/STooltipDemo.vue'
</script>

Hover or focus the button below to reveal the tooltip — it activates via `interestFor`, not a click.

<div class="demo-surface">

<STooltipDemo />

</div>

```vue
<script setup>
import { SButton, SText, STooltip } from 'polaris-vue-elements'
</script>

<template>
  <!-- interestFor activates the target on hover/focus, unlike commandFor which
       requires a click/activation. -->
  <SButton interestFor="example-tooltip">Hover or focus me</SButton>

  <STooltip id="example-tooltip">
    <SText>Extra context shown on hover or focus.</SText>
  </STooltip>
</template>
```

## Props

| Prop | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | `string` | A unique identifier for the element. |

## Slots

| Slot | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `default` | The informational text or elements displayed within the tooltip overlay, providing helpful context or explanations when users interact with the associated element. Only accepts text, paragraph components, and raw `textContent`. |
